title: What Claude Fable 5.2 scores and costs next to the models it replaces
intro: Move across four models in Anthropic’s 9 November benchmark table. Each stop shows the same three scores, and the list price per million tokens where our sources give one. The point to notice is that Opus 5.5, the model Anthropic tells most people to start with, costs half as much as Fable 5.2.
note: All scores are Anthropic’s own, from its Fable 5.2 announcement, at each model’s highest available effort with safeguards on, except the Remote Labor Index score for Fable 5.2, which Anthropic reports at High effort. They are not independent results. Fable 5.2’s and Opus 5.5’s prices are from Anthropic. Fable 5.1’s $10 and $50 are from VentureBeat. GPT-6 Astra’s price is not given in these sources, so it is left out. Prices are standard rates per million input and output tokens and leave out fast mode, caching and batch discounts.
